units.text: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Python reads and writes .pptx presentations, creates new presentations from scratch, and saves them as .pptx. It supports adding AutoShape, Table, and Chart objects to slides, applying text formatting via PortionFormat, and configuring slide transitions with TransitionType. It also handles images by reading .png files and embedding them, manages speaker notes through NotesSlideManager, and stores document metadata and comments via DocumentProperties and CommentAuthorCollection.
It opens, creates, and saves presentations through Presentation as a context manager, ensuring proper disposal, and writes them to .pptx or related Office Open XML variants using SaveFormat.
It adds and formats AutoShapes, tables, and connectors, and applies character-level text formatting through PortionFormat, including font height, bold styling, and solid fill color.
It builds charts with various types using ChartType, populates them with data through an embedded ChartDataWorkbook, and supports series, categories, titles, legends, and data labels.
It applies slide transitions with different types, including CIRCLE, and configures per-slide advance behavior with click and time-based triggers.

It styles shapes with solid, gradient, pattern, and picture fills via FillFormat, line properties through LineFormat, and visual effects such as outer shadow, inner shadow, glow, blur, reflection, and soft edge via EffectFormat.

It manages presentation metadata with DocumentProperties, adds speaker notes per slide using NotesSlideManager, and handles threaded comments with CommentAuthorCollection including authors, timestamps, and positions.
It embeds images from file handles or bytes using ImageCollection.add_image and places them on slides as picture frames.
It exports presentations to Markdown in various flavor dialects through SaveFormat.MD, preserving text frames, tables, lists, headings, comments, and chart data.
This example opens an existing presentation to count its slides and save it, then creates a new presentation and saves it, demonstrating basic file I/O with Aspose.Slides FOSS for Python.
The following examples demonstrate common tasks using Aspose.Slides FOSS for Python.
Add a rectangle shape with text.
Format text with font height, bold, and solid fill color.
Add a table with rows and columns.
Connect two shapes with a bent connector.
Fill a shape with a solid color.
Embed an image from a file.
Add speaker notes to a slide.
Add a threaded comment to a slide.
Set document properties and custom values.
Build a clustered column chart from scratch.
Apply a circle slide transition with timing.
Group multiple shapes under one name.
Import the aspose-slides-foss package.
The primary entry point is slides_foss.Presentation, which owns a SlideCollection of Slide objects, each exposing its shapes through Slide.shapes (a ShapeCollection).

The slides_foss.Presentation class provides access to slides, masters, layout slides, images, document properties, and comment authors, and supports saving presentations in formats defined by slides_foss.export.SaveFormat. The slides_foss.slideshow.TransitionType enumeration defines slide transition effects, while slides_foss.animation.Sequence and slides_foss.charts.Chart provide programmatic control over animation sequences and chart rendering, respectively.
It adds full non-PPTX export (PDF, HTML, images, and more), SmartArt and OLE support, VBA and digital signature handling, and commercial support.
BaseHandoutNotesSlideHeaderFooterManager class manages header and footer elements for handout and notes slides.
BaseShapeLock class provides base locking functionality for shapes.
GeometryShape class represents a shape with geometric properties derived from Shape, IGeometryShape, and ABC.
GraphicalObject class represents a graphical object derived from Shape, IGraphicalObject, and ABC.
GraphicalObjectLock class provides locking functionality for graphical objects derived from BaseShapeLock.

IBasePortionFormat interface defines base formatting properties for text portions including alternative_language_id, complex_script_font, east_asian_font, effect_format, escapement, fill_format, font_bold, font_height, and spell_check.
IEffectParamSource interface represents a source of effect parameters.
IFillParamSource interface represents a source of fill parameters.
ILineParamSource interface represents a source of line parameters.
ILoadOptions interface defines options for loading presentations.
IMasterLayoutSlideCollection interface represents a collection of master layout slides derived from ILayoutSlideCollection and ABC.

IParagraphFormat interface defines paragraph formatting properties including alignment, bullet, default_portion_format, default_tab_size, depth, east_asian_line_break, font_alignment, and hanging_punctuation.
IPortionFormat interface defines portion formatting properties derived from IBasePortionFormat, IHyperlinkContainer, and ABC.
ISection interface represents a section in a presentation.
IThreeDParamSource interface represents a source of three-dimensional parameters.
Images class provides methods from_file and from_stream to create image objects, and raises TypeError conditionally.

ParagraphFormat class implements paragraph formatting properties including alignment, bullet, default_portion_format, default_tab_size, depth, east_asian_line_break, font_alignment, and hanging_punctuation.
PortionFormat class implements portion formatting properties including hyperlink_click and hyperlink_mouse_over derived from BasePortionFormat and IPortionFormat.
BehaviorProperty class represents animation behavior properties including extrusion_auto_rotation_center, extrusion_back_depth, extrusion_color, and extrusion_color_mode.
IBehaviorProperty interface defines behavior property properties including is_custom and value.
ChartPortionFormat class represents formatting for chart text portions derived from IChartPortionFormat and BasePortionFormat.
IChartCategoryCollection interface defines methods for managing chart categories including add, clear, index_of, remove, remove_at, and use_cells.
IChartDataWorksheet interface defines properties index and name for chart data worksheets.
IChartSeriesCollection interface defines methods for managing chart series including add, clear, index_of, insert, remove, and remove_at.
IChartSeriesReadonlyCollection interface represents a read-only collection of chart series.
IImageTransformOperation interface represents an image transform operation.
ImageTransformOperation class implements image transform operations derived from PVIObject, ISlideComponent, IPresentationComponent, and IImageTransformOperation.
IThemeable interface defines properties as_i_presentation_component, as_i_slide_component, presentation, and slide for themeable objects.
